content.title: Steel Ball Run JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure Netflix Anime Release Date, Trailer, English Dub Cast
content.text: Pony Up For 1st STAGE of STEEL BALL RUN JoJo's Bizarre AdventureThe first episode (47 min) of the new installment is now streamingBy Tudum StaffMarch 19, 2026Yippee-ki-yay — or should we say yare yare daze… The Joestar family saga continues with a new installment of JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure: STEEL BALL RUN JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure is the highly anticipated adaptation of Part 7 of legendary artist Hirohiko Akari’s beloved manga series, and the 1st STAGE episode is now streaming.Says director Yasuhiro Kimura, “My heart is pounding with excitement to be entrusted with directing this anime adaptation. The entire staff shares this feeling and is pouring their passion into daily production. I look forward to sharing our enthusiasm for this work with all of you, and hope we can ride this journey together.” The anime adaptation is directed by Yasuhiro Kimura and Hideya Takahashi, and was produced by the same crew who worked on the previous seasons.STEEL BALL RUN is set in the 19th century United States and follows Johnny Joestar, a former jockey who lost the use of his legs in a freak accident. After forming an alliance with mysterious outlaw Gyro Zeppeli, the two embark on a grueling cross-continental horse race for a $50 million grand prize. When is the STEEL BALL RUN JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure release date?1st STAGE (1 episode: 47 minutes) is available now on Netflix. Check back for more information.Where can I watch the trailer?Take a look at the English dub trailer above. For the subbed trailer, check it out below. Who’s in the English cast of STEEL BALL RUN?The English dub cast includes:Daman Mills as Johnny JoestarKaiji Tang as Gyro ZeppeliDamien Haas as Diego BrandoFrankie Kevich as Lucy SteelJamieson Price as Steven SteelAlejandro Antonio Ruiz as SandmanCedric Williams as PocolocoWhat other JoJo anime does Netflix have?You can watch five seasons of JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure on Netflix, including Stone Ocean, Golden Wind, Diamond is Unbreakable, Stardust Crusaders, and Phantom Blood/Battle Tendency.
